Kitchen Notes Recipes

Perfect Roast Chicken

Ingredients

  • 1 whole chicken
  • 1 lemon, halved
  • 1 head garlic
  • Fresh thyme

Directions

Heat the oven to 425 degrees. Remove the giblets, rinse the chicken inside and out, and pat the outside dry with paper towels.

Stuff the cavity with the thyme, both halves of the lemon and the garlic. Brush the outside with butter and season with salt and pepper.

Roast for one and a half hours, until the juices run clear when you cut between a leg and a thigh. Rest for twenty minutes before carving.
